activities.description: Sachi discusses the different ways applicants can know if their application is under Administrative Processing.

She outlines three possible scenarios: 1) The visa officer explicitly informs the applicant during the interview; 2) The applicant's passport is not returned within a week or ten days of the interview; 3) The online application status changes from 'approved' to 'under administrative processing.'
She emphasizes the importance of regularly checking the online application status.
